# axm skills publish

Publish extensions to a registry

## When to use

Publish extensions to a registry

## Usage

```bash
axm skills publish [flags] <extensions...>
```

## Arguments

| Name         | Type   | Required | Description                                                               |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `extensions` | string | Yes      | Extension names or glob patterns (@owner/skills/name, bare name, or glob) |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                        |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--registry`    | string  | No       | Target a specific named registry instead of the default            |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Publish without confirmation                                       |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Bypass version-order warnings; published versions remain immutable |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would be published without uploading                     |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Publish a skill to the registry**

```bash
axm skills publish @acme/skills/code-review
```

**Publish multiple skills matching a pattern**

```bash
axm skills publish effect-* commit
```

**Publish to a specific registry**

```bash
axm skills publish code-review --registry local
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
